title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendor + rke2 ubuntu apt-mirror and tuf metadata updates
author: Asha Mehta
description: Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private in highly regulated environments reported failures when installing the offline bundle on RKE2 clusters that use Ubuntu 22.04 with local apt mirrors. Root causes were twofold: 1) TUF metadata for a small set of packages was stale in the offline vendor bundle which caused apt to fail signature verification when the local mirror performed metadata aggregation; 2) a missing apt-mirror config and init hook in the bundle caused mismatch between the requested package pool and what we vendored. This PR: - Updates the offline bundle vendor artifacts to include refreshed TUF metadata for OS packages and our runtime debs. - Adds an optional apt-mirror configuration and systemd init hook that runs in the airgap bootstrap stage to populate local mirror cache from the bundle. - Adds distro-specific checks and packaging for RKE2 on Ubuntu 22.04 and Ubuntu 20.04 (minor packaging adjustments). - Vendors an additional small set of base images (containerd, runc, cri-tools) and pins image digests in the bundle manifest to avoid OCI registry resolution during bootstrap. - Adds an automated verification script (ci/airgap/validate_bundle.sh) used by CI to simulate apt/mirror validation and TUF verification in a minimal chroot. Changeset summary: - offline-bundle/ubuntu/22.04/tuf-metadata/ updated (refreshed snapshots and targets) - offline-bundle/ubuntu/apt-mirror/ new config templates and install hook - offline-bundle/images/ pinned new images and added digests - installer/airgap/bootstrap.sh updated to run apt-mirror hook when enabled - installer/airgap/README.md updated with instructions and troubleshooting steps - ci/airgap/validate_bundle.sh added - docs/onprem/airgap-ubuntu.md updated Testing: - Local validation runs using ci/airgap/validate_bundle.sh against a chrooted Ubuntu 22.04 proved TUF signature checks and apt installs succeed when mirror hook is exercised. - Integration smoke test: deployed the bundle to an RKE2 single-node vagrant environment with apt mirror enabled and completed full install + smoke tests (kubelet, containerd start, runtime tests). - CI: added a new pipeline step (airgap-validate) which runs the validate_bundle script in a matrix for ubuntu20.04 and ubuntu22.04. Rollout/migration notes: - This change is additive and gated behind the installer config flag "enable_local_apt_mirror" (default: false). Customers who enable it should ensure their deployment uses the matching apt-mirror path in their bootstrap configuration. - If customers were using custom mirrors, the bundle will not overwrite existing mirror configuration unless enable_local_apt_mirror is explicitly set. Rollback: - The previous bundle remains available in S3 under offline-bundles/<version>/legacy/; the installer checks allow explicit bundle version pinning. Security/TUF notes: - Refreshed TUF metadata was generated using our signing pipeline (signing keys are KMS-protected); audit trail is attached in CI artifacts. - Added a small note in docs about rotating TUF keys and re-vendoring for emergency key rotations. Related: ENG-2381 for long-running vendoring automation; SUP-877 customer support case report. See also previous vendoring PRs for other distros.
commits: feat(airgap): refresh TUF metadata for ubuntu packages
chore(vendor): add apt-mirror templates and systemd hook
chore(bundle): pin additional base images and add digests
feat(ci): add airgap validate script and pipeline step
docs: update onprem airgap ubuntu troubleshooting
discussion: Liam Chen (reviewer): Can we avoid adding more optional hooks in the bootstrap path? We should ensure hooks are idempotent and fail-safe.
Asha Mehta (author): Agreed. The apt-mirror hook runs only when enable_local_apt_mirror=true and is written to be idempotent; added safety checks to bail if mirror cache already populated.
Nora Alvarez (reviewer): TUF metadata refresh looks good but please include CI artifact link showing signed metadata for audit.
Asha Mehta (author): Added CI artifact link to pipeline logs and included brief note in the README.
release_notes: Add optional local apt-mirror support for air-gapped installers on Ubuntu; refresh TUF metadata and vendor additional base images. Gated behind enable_local_apt_mirror flag.
